steps: Owner A creates property, unit and lease
Confirmed synthetic tenant claims link through signup and callback
Tenant submits repair with photo and messages
Owner triages and converts twice; one work order exists

cases.name: authorization boundaries
checks: Owner B cannot read or mutate Owner A records
Unrelated tenant cannot read requests, messages, rent or objects
Forged invite lease/owner and workflow field updates are refused
Direct Pro edits and untrusted billing account hints cannot grant access
Unlink revokes future request/photo authorization; signed-link expiry tested separately

cases.name: failure and concurrency
checks: Competing property creates respect Free capacity
Competing invite claims permit only one verified tenant
Concurrent stock use never overspends availability
Lost response and duplicate completion never double-post records or expenses
Offline queue survives auth switch, validation errors, storage failure and reload
Billing retry/order and deletion-vs-renewal preserve correct state

cases.name: account and device recovery
checks: Signup, confirmation and recovery callbacks on web and physical iOS/Android
Password update remains bound to initiating identity
Deletion resumes after partial cleanup, reload and missing profile
New account never inherits another account's confirmation or pending operations
Notification denied/disabled and provider outage remain visible

cases.name: data correctness and usability
checks: Mixed currencies never merge
Date-only values retain their day in Atlantic/Pacific timezones
Old receipts keep entered dates and export in full across pages
Search/filter context survives navigation
Keyboard and screen-reader labels work
Oversized/mismatched/active-content uploads and path traversal are refused
